race.description: Ladbrokes Flex Your Multi Stays Alive Mdn Plate
race.comment: BETTER OPTION (1) is ready to break through after back-to-back seconds, most recently losing by a lip here as favourite. He had valid excuses for his half-length defeat at Townsville, losing ground early and facing running issues around the turn. Ready. CHICA PODEROSA (4) poses a main challenge and has only missed the frame once here from five starts. Strips fitter third-up and is drawn to get all the favours from the inside. DIVINE SOUL (2) was second at Townsville despite being forced wide. Should be at his top now and keeps the claimer. WATEGO'S BAY (7) returns and it's worth noting she found the line well here on debut last prep. Looks best of the rest.
